prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1247; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured reports stopping at a red light when the vehicle behind made contact at moderate speed. Both drivers exchanged information at the scene. Police report requested. Initial liability appears to favor our insured's position pending review of the other driver's statement.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel, who has notified this office that all communication should be directed through the firm. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness with headache onset within 24 hours. Medical records requested through counsel. Vehicle damage photos received from the appraiser and reviewed; rear bumper and tail lamp assembly show significant impact.

Entry 3: Spoke with defense counsel's office regarding the claimant's treatment history. Claimant is currently under chiropractic care and has been referred for physical therapy. Counsel indicates a demand package will follow once treatment concludes. No settlement discussion has taken place at this stage.

Entry 4: Reviewed the independent medical examination scheduling request from our panel. Claimant's attorney has requested that the exam be scheduled at a location within a reasonable distance of the claimant's residence. Coordination with the vendor is underway. Reserve remains open pending receipt of complete medical documentation.

Entry 5: Received the claimant's medical billing summary through counsel. Treatment consists of conservative care for soft tissue injury consistent with whiplash mechanism. No surgical recommendations noted in the records provided so far. File flagged for supervisor review at the next scheduled claims meeting to evaluate reserve adequacy and next steps toward resolution.
